# Godly MCP Server

A local, read-only MCP server that searches Godly.Design's publicly listed collections and retrieves a site's public detail page. It uses the site's published collection pages and sitemap, not private endpoints or browser cookies. Requests are rate-limited and cached in memory for five minutes.

## Tools

- `godly_search`: search current public listings across websites, apps, templates, posts, tools, resources, logos, icons, OG images, and section collections. Filter by collection such as `hero`, `cta`, or `footer`.
- `godly_get_site`: retrieve a public Godly website detail page, including its description, outbound website URL, and publicly listed screenshot/section image

records.readme_excerpt:
# Pinterest MCP Server

A local, read-only MCP server for Pinterest API v5. It provides public Pin discovery search when the developer app has Pinterest's beta endpoint enabled, plus search across Pins and Boards owned by the authenticated account.

## Tools

- `pinterest_search_public_pins`: public Pin search via `GET /search/partner/pins`. Pinterest marks this API endpoint as beta and does not enable it for every app.
- `pinterest_search_my_pins`: search Pins owned by the connected account.
- `pinterest_search_my_boards`: search boards owned by the connected account.
- `pinterest_get_my_account`: verify the connected account.

All tools are read-only. This server cannot create Pins or chan

# Continuous-recording RC Training walkthrough

## Guided entry revision

The current composition now demonstrates instructions and Enter RC Training, single-passage/full-section selection, mandatory microphone startup, the visible active timer, hidden paragraph recall, checking, saved completion and last passage time, then end feedback. No silent alternative or optional clock control is shown. Completion time is explicitly illustrative. All original LSAT source text is preserved.

Delivery target: `renders/rc-training-demo-guided.mp4`, app cache key `guided-v3`. Browser gate passed with zero runtime, layout or motion errors, 89 of 89 contrast checks, and 10 structural composition warnings.

records.readme_excerpt:
# Skill dependency verification

Local repair/test tools for the 2026-10-11 research-deep and bootcamp-parity-audit dependency repairs. This is an auxiliary verification project outside the Obsidian vault. It does not change the LSAT U application, query paid services or publish anything.

The isolated `.venv` contains PyYAML 6.0.3. To recreate it, use `uv venv .venv` and `uv pip install --python .venv/Scripts/python.exe pyyaml==6.0.3`. Do not add dependencies to the vault.

# Taste Vault

**Inspiration in, vocabulary out.** A local, zero-build design-taste gallery that turns screenshots of sites you love into objective design vocabulary, clustered collections, and paste-ready briefs for Codex, Claude Code and other coding assistants.

Built as the companion tool for the video **[Turn Claude Into A Design GENIUS In 3 Simple Steps](https://youtu.be/7FU98O0JLHs)**. This repo ships with my real vault — 46 entries across 12 collections plus my House DNA — so you can see the whole system working before you replace my taste with yours.

# Save available YouTube captions in one command

This free Python CLI saves timestamped Markdown, original caption cues in JSON, provenance, SHA-256 hashes and a coverage report. It does not summarize. It tries youtube-transcript-api once, then your shared yt-dlp install once. It never downloads video/audio or exports browser credentials.

From this project directory:

```powershell
uv run youtube-transcript "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7xTGNNLPyMI" --out "C:\Users\Joshu\dev\ai-os\raw\inbox\youtube\7xTGNNLPyMI"
```
